bayts.text: From me, to Him to Whom belong Existence and Beginningless Eternity, praise and thanks; and He has accepted (my) services.
The Possessor of Permanence and Dissimilarity (from creatures) has benefited this servant, the Servant (al-Khadīm), without contradiction.
To Him for Whom Self-Subsistence is necessary I have conveyed my sincerity, and He has bestowed a wonder.
To Allah, Lord of the worlds, belongs Oneness; and He alone has spared me every harm.
To Him my gratitude forever, for the essential attribute (an-nafsiyya); and He has been for me with well-pleasing glad tidings.
Power and Will have brought me what I love, and the Most High has willed it.
The Possessor of Knowledge and the Possessor of Life have decreed what makes my life clear forever.
Toward me Hearing and Sight have led what I longed for of wishes, and my harm was cut off.
To me the Possessor of Speech has led His wise Remembrance, and has kept for me what was hidden from every sage.
An Able One (Qādir), Willing (Murīd), has extended toward me a secret through which the rebel (al-marīd) has not come against me.
A Knowing (ʿĀlim) and Living (Ḥayy) One has preserved all of me from adversities and made my little abundant.
A Hearing (Samīʿ) and Seeing (Baṣīr) One has ransomed my soul with everyone who formerly wished to crush me.
And to me a Speaking One (Mutakallim) has drawn the Book, and to my hand and my heart the (divine) attraction.
There has remained for me an Everlasting One, without helper, with the derived attributes (al-maʿnawiyya) and the attributes of meaning (al-maʿānī).
